title: Keep commit messages imperative
body: Write commit messages in the imperative mood: 'Fix bug' not 'Fixed bug'. This matches the convention used across the portfolio repos.

title: Use .daily-pause to skip a run
body: Touch .daily-pause in the repo root to pause Daily Green for that repo only. Remove the file to resume. Useful when a repo is in active development and you don't want daily commits.

title: Verify branch before pushing
body: Always run `git status` and `git diff --stat` before pushing to a shared branch. This catches uncommitted changes and accidental commits to the wrong branch.

title: Check GitHub token scopes
body: If PR creation or draft-state updates fail, check token scopes with `gh auth status`. The `repo` scope is required for write operations on pull requests.

title: Architecture scan is idempotent
body: The architecture scan script only commits when the report content changes. Running it multiple times per day produces no extra commits — safe for CI schedules.
